page.content:
Janeway's stranded Delta Quadrant company.

How Voyager crew connects

  • Character: Kathryn Janeway — Janeway captains the Voyager crew.
  • Faction: Starfleet — Voyager remains a Starfleet crew in the Delta Quadrant.
  • Ship: USS Voyager — Janeway's crew is stranded aboard Voyager.
  • Character: Seven of Nine — Seven of Nine becomes part of the Voyager crew.

What is Voyager crew?

The Voyager crew mixes Starfleet and Maquis under Janeway — Paris, Torres, Tuvok, Kim, the Doctor, and later Seven — seventy thousand light years from home.

Key threads lead to Kathryn Janeway, Starfleet, USS Voyager and Seven of Nine.
